# Cutting Edge Carpentry

> Cutting Edge Carpentry INC. is a family-owned residential carpentry and construction company based at 55737 Main Street, Straffordville, Ontario, Canada, led by owner Abram (Abe) Thiessen. It frames custom homes and builds decks, covered porches, fences, additions, basements, garages and shops, and refinishes exterior wood across Southwestern Ontario.

- Phone: (519) 902-5029
- Email: cecarpentry22@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6637215692643142071

## Services

- [Custom home framing](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/custom-homes/): framing and builder support for new custom homes
- [Residential framing](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/residential-framing/): rough framing for homes, additions, garages and renovations
- [Home renovations](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/home-renovations/): renovation framing, structural openings and layout changes
- [Additions](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/additions/): home addition framing and tie-ins
- [Basement framing](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/basement-framing/): basement wall framing and layout
- [Garages and shops](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/garages-shops/): detached garage, shop and lean-to framing
- [Decks](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/decks/): new and replacement wood decks, stairs and railings
- [Covered porches](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/covered-porches/): covered porches, porch roofs and covered patios
- [Fences](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/fences/): wood privacy fences and gates
- [Deck and fence refinishing](https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/services/refinishing/): cleaning and re-coating exterior wood

## Service area

Based in Straffordville (Municipality of Bayham, Elgin County). Serves London, Byron, Lambeth, Komoka, St. Thomas, Port Stanley, Aylmer, Port Burwell, Tillsonburg, Delhi, Simcoe, Port Dover, Dorchester, Ingersoll and Woodstock. Full list: https://cuttingedgecarpentryinc.com/service-area/
